text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Here it isーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you pick up trash around the school today,
great fortune will smile upon you!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa~, t-that's wonderful!
Looks like salvation really does exist~!

text_block_list.name: Consultee
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... But picking up trash around campus is a solo job, right?
That's kind of a pain...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nyonyo!? But just picking up trash will guarantee us a lucky, happy future, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "This once-in-a-lifetime happy chance... if I could take your place, I totally would!"

text_block_list.name: Consultee
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Then Fuku-chan and the others should help out too.
That way, we can all be happy together!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-Is something like that really possible...?
W-What should we do, Fukukitaru-san...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Very well! On the pride of this fortune teller's shop,
let me give your luck a big boost-!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haaah, wheeeze... I cleaned the whole academy till it was sparkling, but good luck still hasn't come my way, has it...

text_block_list.name: Consultee
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, no way!
I worked so hard because I believed in you, Fuku-chan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, but it might just be the kind of omen
that doesn't show results right away—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, you're that pony-chan who often brings refreshments
and comes to watch our practices, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Were you cleaning up? It's wonderful that
you work hard even when no one is watching ♪

text_block_list.name: Consultee
text_block_list.text:
Hyoe... Lady Fuji...!
Th-Th-Th-Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
L-Look, Fukukitaru-san~!
I think Lucky just woke up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~, as expected of Lady Shiraoki!
Her divine favor is unmistakable! Nice fortune boost!!
Hey, you guys!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep the noise down in the hallway.
...Were you running that fortune-telling booth on school grounds again?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Gyaaaah, Air Groove-san?! U-Um, but look, just as promised, I'm not trying to sell any shady pottery, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right~!
I haven't handed out talismans, dolls, or good-luck cookies at all~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, I received a report that you've been voluntarily cleaning the school grounds. On behalf of the student council, I came to express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To the two of you, take this—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hae? What's this little scrap of paper...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Here's a free coupon for a honey drink.
I can't use it since I'm tuning up before a race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, you two can go together.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whaa... Th-Thank you so much!
Fukukitaru-san, some good luck
has come our way too...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Sharing good fortune! As expected of Great Shiraoki-sama,
her aftercare is flawless too!!"
